source_type: own release via mirror (BioBERT-preprocessed GAD, re-hosted by BigBIO; the BLURB/BioBERT Google Drive original is dead)
license: CC BY 4.0 (BigBIO card); original GAD corpus (Bravo et al. 2015) homepage unreachable
single_request: yes (via ClinicBench prompt template; raw data is binary sentence classification)
request_fields: ClinicBench Table 8 GAD prompt (gene/disease relation yes/no) + sentence with @GENE$ and @DISEASE$ masks
notes: ClinicBench (Liu et al., EMNLP 2024; github.com/AI-in-Health/ClinicBench @57138be8a73f09bef8980f849789baf57570c5cf) releases only its six new datasets; existing datasets are not redistributed, so the own release was used. ClinicBench takes GAD from BLURB (test 534). BLURB's download script fetches REdata.zip from Google Drive (id 1-jDKGcXREb2X9xTFnuiJ36PvsqoyHWcw), which now returns 404; BigBIO hosts the same REdata.zip (2,973,735 bytes, sha256 b3317c119db6a8c5895e8c7464590e4a2e5f00ae7078745cf6adc9cbef42bd2e). The zip bundles 10 CV folds with train files; only GAD/1/test.tsv was extracted, then the zip was deleted. 534 sentences (281 positive, 253 negative), matching ClinicBench Table 1. Checked 2026-10-04; no LLMs or API keys used.
